Yellow.flavor: All knuckles and no neck, it complains right up until it doesn't.

Red.flavor: Twitchy legs, empty head, gone before you blink twice.

Blue.flavor: One good eye and a better trigger; useless the second you're inside its arms.

Purple.flavor: Slinks in, bites once, forgets to leave a body.

Grey.flavor: Doesn't have a weak side, and hates that you keep looking for one.

prairies.name: Puffgrub
prairies.flavor: Rolls through the grass eating grass, offering nothing, fearing everything.

wetlands.name: Slopnewt
wetlands.flavor: Half mud, half meat, all squeal.

mountains.name: Snowpudge
mountains.flavor: Rolls downhill faster than it ever runs uphill, and it never runs uphill.

beach.name: Tidewad
beach.flavor: Washes up, flops around, apparently thinks that's a plan.

volcanic.name: Ashpup
volcanic.flavor: Somehow still alive out here, mostly out of spite.

Yellow.name: The Knucklebreaker
Yellow.flavor: Picks a fight with the ground first, just to prove it can lose and get up anyway.

Red.name: The Redline Ripper
Red.flavor: Hits top speed somewhere between your first step back and your last.

Blue.name: The Deadeye Warden
Blue.flavor: Already locked onto you before you noticed the grass move.

Purple.name: The Throatgrin
Purple.flavor: You won't hear it coming. You'll just stop being able to breathe.

Grey.name: The Ashmaw
Grey.flavor: Doesn't have a specialty. Doesn't need one.

Fins.name: The Mudking
Fins.flavor: Rules a puddle like an ocean, and will drown you just to prove the point.

Claws.name: The Cragfather
Claws.flavor: Older than the rocks it squats on, meaner than every single one of them.

Coat.name: The Frostback
Coat.flavor: Grew a second hide out of spite for the cold, then started collecting more.

Heat.name: The Cinderjaw
Heat.flavor: Breathes the vent like air and looks at you like lunch.

apex.name: The Main Course
apex.flavor: You spent five biomes learning how to eat. Nothing has ever eaten it back.
